title: Why the GitHub Pages site is not live — a configuration fault, not a content fault
claim: The published site is down because GitHub Pages is configured to deploy from a branch (legacy) and every legacy build has failed since 2026-11-16T01:02Z, while the repository's own deployer (.github/workflows/pages.yml) uses actions/deploy-pages, which can only publish when the Pages source is 'GitHub Actions'. The two are mutually exclusive, and no amount of CI green changes that.

evidence.result: status: errored; build_type: legacy; source: {branch: main, path: /}
evidence.why_it_matters: build_type 'legacy' means Pages publishes a branch build, not the Actions artifact. Under this setting actions/deploy-pages in pages.yml cannot publish.

evidence.result: 8 consecutive builds 2026-11-16T01:02:23Z .. 02:19:57Z all 'errored' with 'Page build failed.'; the last successful build the board records is afc79f2 at 2026-11-15T23:44:35Z
evidence.why_it_matters: The branch build itself is failing, repeatedly, across eight different commits. It is not one bad commit.

evidence.check: repository content (ruling out the usual causes, not guessing)
evidence.result: 15.4 MB across 720 tracked files; largest file 1.28 MB; no symlinks; no non-ASCII or reserved filenames; .nojekyll present and tracked at the published root; no _config.yml or Gemfile
evidence.why_it_matters: Rules out the documented causes of 'Page build failed': the 1 GB site limit, the 100 MB file limit, broken symlinks and Jekyll Liquid errors. The failure is not caused by the content being published.
The session token cannot change Pages settings. This fix requires the repository owner.

not_claimed: That the probe-run backlog was the cause. It was a real contributor (six hour-long probe runs were queued ahead of the publisher at 02:0xZ) and it is fixed on this branch, but it is not why Pages reads 'errored'.

That switching the source to GitHub Actions will definitely succeed. It is the configuration pages.yml was written for; whether the first Actions deploy then succeeds can only be confirmed after the switch.
The specific internal reason GitHub's branch build fails. That is visible only in Settings > Pages, which this session cannot read.

owner_action_required.what: Set Source to 'GitHub Actions' (currently 'Deploy from a branch' -> main / root).
owner_action_required.then: Re-run the 'Publish static site to GitHub Pages' workflow on main, or push any commit to main.
owner_action_required.why: This is the only setting under which .github/workflows/pages.yml, which this repository has used since PR #27, can publish. Until it is set, the site cannot go live regardless of CI status.

sources.what: GitHub's documentation for the Pages publishing source, including the GitHub Actions option
